story.title: Nairobi county budget passes after a long night
story.dek: The assembly approved the spending plan with amendments to transport and water, ending weeks of standoff.
story.body:
The county assembly passed the 2026 spending plan shortly after midnight, closing a standoff that had held up road repairs and water works across the capital.

## What changed

Members added 1.2 billion shillings for drainage in Kibra and moved a further 400 million into a ward-level water programme. The executive had resisted both amendments for three weeks.

> We got the money where the flooding actually is.

The finance executive said the programme would be financed without new borrowing, drawing on unspent allocations from the previous financial year. Officials will report to the assembly every quarter.
